title: Reader explanation draft — not a business record, RecordSet, execution Result or scientific approval
description: Internal model-to-host draft for reader.explain. This operation has an empty output_record_types whitelist, so the draft has no place to put a business payload: it carries human-facing explanation attachments, declared gaps and follow-up requests only. The host owns record envelopes, real execution attribution and validation. A shape-valid draft is not evidence, not a readability approval and not support for any claim.

attribution.description: What this draft may say about its own producer. There is no value for independence: only the host can establish that the explaining principal differs from the producer of the explained material.

target_ref.description: The exact business object being explained, or null when the brief has no business target yet.

basis_refs.description: The exact records this explanation was read from. An explanation is traceable or it is declared ungrounded in gaps; it is never citable as support.

records.description: Structurally empty. reader.explain has no output_record_types; this array exists only so that a business record has a place to fail.
